title: Introduction to Sanity CMS
excerpt: Learn the basics of Sanity CMS and how to get started with your first project.
body: Sanity is a powerful headless CMS that gives you complete control over your content. In this article, we'll explore the fundamentals of setting up a Sanity project, defining schemas, and querying your content.

title: Building a Blog with Next.js and Sanity
excerpt: A comprehensive guide to creating a modern blog using Next.js and Sanity as your content backend.
body: Combining Next.js with Sanity creates a powerful stack for building performant, content-rich websites. This tutorial walks through the entire process from project setup to deployment.

title: Understanding GROQ Queries
excerpt: Master GROQ, Sanity's query language, with practical examples and best practices.
body: GROQ (Graph-Relational Object Queries) is Sanity's powerful query language. Unlike SQL, GROQ is designed specifically for querying JSON documents and relationships.

title: Image Optimization in Sanity
excerpt: Learn how to leverage Sanity's image pipeline for optimal performance.
body: Sanity's image CDN provides powerful transformations and optimizations out of the box. This guide covers hotspot, crop, and various transformation options.

title: Portable Text Deep Dive
excerpt: Everything you need to know about Sanity's rich text format.
body: Portable Text is Sanity's specification for rich text. Unlike HTML, it's structured data that can be transformed into any format.

title: Schema Design Best Practices
excerpt: Design maintainable and scalable schemas for your Sanity projects.
body: Good schema design is crucial for a successful Sanity project. This article covers naming conventions, field organization, and common patterns.

title: Real-time Collaboration Features
excerpt: Explore Sanity's powerful real-time collaboration capabilities.
body: Sanity enables multiple editors to work on the same document simultaneously without conflicts. Learn how this works under the hood.

title: Migrating from WordPress to Sanity
excerpt: Step-by-step guide for migrating your WordPress content to Sanity.
body: Moving from WordPress to Sanity opens up new possibilities for your content. This guide covers the migration process, including posts, pages, and media.

title: Custom Input Components
excerpt: Build custom form inputs to enhance your Studio experience.
body: Sanity Studio's extensibility allows you to create custom input components for unique editing experiences. This tutorial shows you how.

title: Sanity Webhooks and Integrations
excerpt: Connect Sanity to external services using webhooks and APIs.
body: Webhooks allow you to trigger actions when content changes. Learn to integrate Sanity with services like Vercel, Netlify, and custom backends.
